paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 8, halakhah 2, reporting in the name of Shmuel.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source explicitly gives Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot chapter 8 halakhah 2, without independent named-edition verification.

The heading figure is the understood reporter in Shmuel’s name; the content is not supplied, and the standard brief formula is not treated as a missing passage. Yose’s title remains R', father Kahana has full Rav, and Shmuel gains no title.
